prerequisites: Achieved the second study section, demonstrating at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know both formal and content requirements for a Bachelor's thesis.
Students are familiar with the basic scientific working methods to be applied in the context of writing a thesis.
Students have a better understanding of how a thesis is structured, how objectives/hypotheses are defined, and how findings from the work are to be presented.
Students know how to structure and concisely convey extensive scientific work to a broad audience.
Students are skilled in arguing factually and objectively and dealing with constructive criticism.
Students are aware that explicit time management is required for the successful completion of a thesis.

syllabus_topics: Selection of the first examiner, selection of the second examiner
Methods of scientific work: research, traceability and reproducibility, correct citation and plagiarism-free work
assessment_rules: The written examination takes place in the form of an online test in the Moodle course 'Seminar Bachelorarbeit', which must be successfully completed. The online test has a duration of 15 minutes.
